v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Qui vult veníre post me, * ábneget semetípsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequátur me.
text.en: If any man will come after me, * let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.

text.la: Deus, qui nos beáti Polycárpi Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, cuius natalítia cólimus, de eiúsdem étiam protectióne gaudeámus.
text.en: O God, who year by year dost gladden us by the solemn feast day of thy Blessed Martyr and Bishop Polycarp, mercifully grant that we who keep his birthday, may ever feel the joyful effects of his protection.
